entities.name: Redware Peoples and Early Settlement
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The earliest known inhabitants of Jamaica, referred to as the Redware people (related to the Saladoid culture), who migrated from South America and established fishing and foraging communities along the coastline.
